%1$s refused to share this folder with Driveway. Android apps connect from ports above 1024, which NFS servers refuse unless told otherwise: add \"insecure\" to the export in /etc/exports (on Synology, tick \"Allow connections from non-privileged ports\"), and check that the export allows this device\'s address and standard security (sec=sys), not only Kerberos.

The rename stopped part way: some files are in the new folder and the rest are still in the old one. Move them across to finish.
Couldn\'t replace the file on %1$s, and couldn\'t put the old one back. The old one is in the same folder, with a name that starts with .driveway-old-, and your new version is safe on this device.
